'''2007 Worlds Day 3 Jonny Chu DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Sheet Jerry/Jimmy Chu → Jonny Chu. Several OCR titles may redlink (Imperial Influence (V), Entwined With A Corellian (V), I'll Let You Go For Now (V), Masterful Move).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
